notes: SHIP v1.14.413 - A RACK WITH NO DEVICES NOW SAYS WHAT THAT MEANS. THIS SHIP EXISTS BECAUSE THE SAME HONEST DATA WAS REPORTED AS A REGRESSION TWICE. At v1.14.401 an empty s3:172 was called a release-blocking functional regression and a full production rollback was ordered; the cab was genuinely empty and the rollback would have un-built the Build workspace and deleted four data-safety ships. At v1.14.411 row s4 came up 0/0 across 24 cabs, was reported as vanished deployment data, and stopped a sprint for a full trace. BOTH TIMES THE DATA WAS CORRECT AND THE SENTENCE WAS MISSING. 0/0 RACKED is arithmetically true and operationally useless: it reads exactly like a broken surface, so the operator cannot tell an unprovisioned cabinet from a failed one. THE INVESTIGATION FOUND NO DEFECT, and that is recorded because it is the expensive part. All ten functions on the Master-to-rack-to-slots-to-counts path are BYTE-IDENTICAL from before the UI sprint through this ship - deploy_forge_master, deploy_forge_rackList, deploy_forge_slots, master_rackToElevation, master_extractRu, master_hostType, master_nodeHeightInfo, statusOf, _phantom_master_bootRestore, phantom_parseMaster. The save/load round-trip is LOSSLESS, proven by running the real PHANTOM_MASTER_STORE.save then load in the real page: 6 hosts in, 6 hosts out, 6 slots rebuilt from the restored rack. No test fixture can reach a device - the harness runs in ephemeral browser contexts. The owner confirmed the verdict: row s4 is cabled and not yet provisioned, so 0/0 is the truth. WHAT IT SAYS, AND WHAT IT IS FORBIDDEN TO SAY. Per the RACKENGINE-SPEC section 7.1 ruling this reports what the MASTER knows, never what the floor contains: PHANTOM has no build-state column anywhere in SITE-VARS, so empty cabinet, ready to rack would be fabricated presence - the same class of lie as inventing a device. The wording is therefore about the FILE: NO HOST DATA IN MASTER. The cable count is the source half of section 9 and it is the tell that separates the two real cases at a glance - cables present means a cabling-only cab the Master knows about (patch, OOB, spine; the real s3:172 carries 31 out and 44 in), zero cables means a cab the Master merely mentions. The app already held that metadata and discarded it. IT IS CYAN, NOT GOLD AND NOT RED. Gold is the attention channel (a human must act) and red is fault. A cabinet the Master carries no hosts for is neither; painting it as a fault is precisely the misreading that cost a near-rollback and a stopped sprint. FOUR SURFACES, ONE SENTENCE: the status pill, the detail meta line (which carried the same misleading count while its row and position clauses stayed true and were kept), a cyan callout at the top of the detail table where a bare header row used to stand over an empty grid, and the detail hint, which instructed TAP A ROW TO TOGGLE RACKED / PENDING under a table with no rows to tap - an instruction for an unavailable action is the same dishonesty as the count. A CLIPPING DEFECT WAS FOUND AND FIXED IN THE SAME PASS, not caused by it. With a flagged rack the row read id plus 0/6 RACKED - 6 FLAGGED plus TAP FLANKS TO WALK, which ran to x=445 inside a 372px row; the row is nowrap by the one-baseline ruling, so it CLIPPED, and what got clipped was the warning clause. It never appeared in earlier measurements because every probe string was unflagged. One rule now governs it: the walk pill is the first thing to go whenever the state pill has something specific to say - it is a standing instruction the caption already carries. Measured at 390 across six states including a full 48U rack fully flagged: worst right edge 360px against a 372px row, one baseline, zero horizontal overflow in every state. THIS SHIP ALSO CARRIES THE PARKED STEP 3 WORK (v1.14.412 was stamped but never pushed when the field report arrived): the desktop composition is gated in CSS at min-width 1024px instead of behind a URL flag nobody types, so a laptop stops rendering 720px of content centred in 1440 with a phone bottom nav; the type ladder is fixed at every tier with a seventh display step; the desktop shell is on the design system with five cyan-to-violet gradients and eight sub-44px controls retired; the shared header pill went 27px to the 44px floor, which exposed and removed a top:-9px nudge that had been pushing a control INTO the iPhone notch; and 97 suite failures were triaged and fixed - one of them a real defect where the desktop top bar painted over the Forge sheet and made its close button unreachable. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces 4579/4579 balanced, CRLF intact with 0 lone LF, 0 lone CR and 0 control bytes, three-stamp lockstep. RACK SCENE LOCK respected. ?legacy=1 unaffected - every selector is scoped to #forge3d-sheet. DEVICE-VERIFY: clear the service-worker cache, confirm v1.14.413, open the aisle on row s4 and focus any cab - the status pill must read NO HOST DATA IN MASTER with a cable count where the Master carries cables, in CYAN and never red; open that rack's detail and confirm the callout explains it and that nothing tells you to tap rows that are not there; then focus a FLAGGED rack on a populated row and confirm the warning clause is fully readable and not clipped.
